title: MySQL: Handle compressed state better
description:
Get rid of the MYSQL_COMPRESS_PAYLOAD state, so the compression
state only moves in one direction. Check the compression state
at the beginning of dissection, and determine the pdu dissection
to pass to tcp_dissect_pdus() based on that.

This prevents changing the compression state before dissecting a PDU
that might throw an exception, and simplifies dissection.

Change the compressed PDU dissection to have the dissector signature;
in the future there it could be registered directly as a dissector
for cases where a capture starts after negotiation of compression.

Put the MySQL compressed header information under a tree.

Related to #19050
